title: Legislative Manual of the State of Minnesota 1893, general election returns (general election 1892-11-08)

offices.president: President (votes for presidential electors by county; when the page prints one column per elector, the column of each party's first elector); only the 1892 general election
offices.house: U.S. Representative in Congress, one table per congressional district; district is the congressional district number (0 for a representative at large); only the 1892 general election
